This small plot near my home is only a tiny piece of my land, but I use it carefully because it is close and I can watch over it every day. I have intercropped it like I always do, mixing crops so my family has different foods through the season. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer for such a small piece, so I mostly put the manure from my animals here because it is free and the soil stays good. I will use my own seeds that I saved, and my daughters and I will work it by hand — no need to hire anyone for such a small plot.
